records.title: DeepSearchQA: Bridging the Comprehensiveness Gap for Deep Research Agents
records.reason: Deep-research QA benchmark measures answer comprehensiveness; no LLM inference-system method.

records.title: LiCoMemory: Lightweight and Cognitive Agentic Memory for Efficient Long-Term Reasoning
records.reason: CogniGraph hierarchically indexes session summaries, triples and source chunks, with time-aware retrieval/reranking and incremental updates. LoCoMo and LongMemEval report accuracy, prompt tokens and retrieval latency gains; evidence is specifically dialogue memory, so validate on inference serving/KV workflows before treating as a runtime optimization.

records.title: Weighted Transformer Network for Machine Translation
records.reason: Machine translation architecture paper is not an LLM inference or serving improvement.

records.title: The OpenHands Software Agent SDK: A Composable and Extensible Foundation for Production Agents
records.reason: SDK architecture is production-agent infrastructure with context-window management and multi-LLM routing, but the paper evaluates reliability/architecture rather than concrete inference compute or serving-efficiency improvements.

records.title: Social Bias in Elicited Natural Language Inferences
records.reason: Study of social bias in elicited inferences is unrelated to inference-system efficiency.
